statement: Metrics are measured on synthetic data and are not real-world performance.

source.label_provenance: Source identities and attributes; separately simulated interaction outcomes, not untouched original appointment outcomes.

offline_policy_estimate.method: Self-normalized inverse propensity scoring on held-out uniformly randomized logged actions. Only factual matches used; not a causal real-world trial.

notes: Time/patient cohorts discard crossing cells instead of random row splitting.
Reminder opened/action-completed labels and choice outcomes never enter predictors.
Only pre-event missed counts are used. Eighteen percent independent target-flip noise plus latent access preferences.
Gap and facility policy constraints are applied equally in held-out scoring and serving.
